text:
Kathy takes nothing from the estate, because her valid prenuptial agreement waived her pretermitted-spouse and other spousal rights. The deed to Kathy also fails: Florida requires two subscribing witnesses, and Bill only "signed and delivered" it. So the condominium stays in the estate and passes to Julie under the will. Tommy takes the pasture land, and Tommy and Julie split the rest of the estate equally.

CONFIDENCE: 66
